provenance.note: original services from engine export 0.2.0 (export commit b481871); harness from this repository

scope: BEFORE FIX: the same integration suite run against the original 0.2.0 decision-worker and aggregator (queue group removed from consumer options), to show which defects each scenario detects. Fault-injection integration run against a single local NATS JetStream server. Not a load, latency, or availability test.

scenarios.name: end_to_end_candidate
scenarios.description: A valid candidate event flows ingest -> C++ decision -> aggregator -> simulated alert.

scenarios.name: fail_closed_ingestion
scenarios.description: Features with null magnitude, null depth, or no event time are rejected at ingestion instead of being coerced.

scenarios.name: invalid_event_dead_lettered
scenarios.description: An event that bypasses the ingestor with a null depth is dead-lettered by the worker and never decided.
scenarios.observed: timed out waiting for dead letter

scenarios.name: poison_message_bounded_redelivery
scenarios.description: An undecodable message is retried exactly 3 times, then dead-lettered (previously dropped silently).
scenarios.observed: timed out waiting for poison dead letter

scenarios.name: revision_zero_replay
scenarios.description: A revision-0 decision replayed with a new message ID (as after the dedupe window) yields one alert, not two.
scenarios.observed: 2 simulated alerts for one event revision

scenarios.name: out_of_order_revision
scenarios.description: An older revision arriving after a newer one is suppressed.

scenarios.name: future_timestamp_rejected
scenarios.description: An event timestamped 60 s in the future is rejected as out of range instead of clamped to zero age.

scenarios.name: worker_restart_resumes
scenarios.description: With the worker stopped (graceful drain), a published event waits in the durable consumer and is processed after restart.

scenarios.name: queue_group_scale_out
scenarios.description: With two worker replicas, each of 20 events is decided exactly once (previously every replica processed every event).
scenarios.observed: timed out waiting for worker-b ready
